reason: As a tech-forward practitioner spending every morning triaging 30 unread WhatsApp client groups, the WhatsApp forwarding bridge and automatic Drive filing give me the exact intake automation I need without forcing stubborn clients into a portal. At ₹12,990 a year for the Pioneer tier with a 30-day money-back guarantee, it is an easy investment to reclaim my time.
objection: My clients will never use an intake portal—they just dump bills on WhatsApp, so I still worry whether manually forwarding documents from 30 client groups will create extra busywork for a 2-person practice.
